title: Annex A.2 - Policies related to AI
description: Working paper for the Annex A.2 control family: AI policy, alignment with other policies, review of the AI policy.

sections.title: AI policy in place
prompts: Confirm a documented AI policy exists, approved by accountable authority.
Confirm version control and approval evidence.

sections.title: Alignment with related policies
prompts: Verify alignment with InfoSec policy, privacy policy, ethics charter.
Confirm conflicts with other policies are resolved.

sections.title: Review of AI policy
prompts: Confirm scheduled reviews; verify last review date.
Confirm review triggers (regulatory change, incident, scope change).

checklists.text: Approved, in-date AI policy on file.
Review log shows policy was reviewed in cycle.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: When was the AI policy last reviewed and what triggered the review?
How do you ensure consistency between AI policy and the privacy policy?
